question: Which city hosted the 2023 Asian games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hangzhou**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Hangzhou, China hosted the 2023 Asian Games from September 23 to October 8, 2023.
 
• The 19th edition of the Asian Games was originally scheduled to take place in 2022, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The slogan for the games was "Heart to Heart, @Future". 
 
• A total of **45 nations** participated in the games, with **11,909 athletes** competing across **481 events** in **40 sports**.
 
• The **opening ceremony** took place on **September 23, 2023**, and was addressed by **Xi Jinping**, the President of China.
 
• The **closing ceremony** was held on **October 8, 2023**, and featured a speech by **Randhir Singh**, the President of the **Olympic Council of Asia**.
 
• Hangzhou was the third Chinese city to host the Asian Games, after Beijing in 1990 and Guangzhou in 2010.
